basics.name: Yuheng (Aaron) Ding
basics.label: Master's of Intelligent Information Systems at Carnegie Mellon University School of Computer Science
basics.summary: Master student at Language Technology Institute focused on Multimodal Reasoning with experience in full-stack development, AI research, and software engineering, joining CMU's MIIS program to deepen expertise in intelligent information systems.

education.studyType: Master of Science in Intelligent Information Systems
Bachelor of Science in Computer Science and Applied Mathematics

publications.name: VISCO: Benchmarking Fine-Grained Critique and Correction Towards Self-Improvement in Visual Reasoning

work experience.name: VisionX LLC
work experience.summary: Collaborate with a team of 4 engineers to architect a full-stack e-commerce platform, with a focus on promoting a healthy lifestyle and fostering environmental sustainability.
highlights: Engineered a product page UI template using Python Django framework for backend and MongoDB for data persistence; streamlined automatic page creation from database; enhanced scalability and amplified product creation efficiency by 400% over manual page inputting.
Improved user information gathering, payment workflow with Stripe API, and email order confirmations; achieved a 30% reduction in checkout process response time.

Collaborated with a colleague to enhance online consulting session reservation system, integrating voice and video chat functionalities by using WebSocket and WebRTC technologies, resulting in 60% decrease in reservation confirmation time.

research experience.summary: Developed a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating visual language models (VLMs) on perception and reasoning quality in QA tasks
highlights: Developed an intuitive annotation tool that improved the annotator experience, enabling efficient curation of over 1,600 fine-grained annotated samples for a high-quality dataset.
Tested on over 25 VLMs to assess self-critique and correction abilities.
Introduced a novel evaluation metric, namely VISCore, which incorporated answer accuracy, step-wise critique accuracy, and critique quality, leading to more accurate assessments.
Improved critique accuracy by 8% through agent-based critique generation.

research experience.summary: Refined a graph theory solution to minimize tests and time used in identifying infection within a community network using Python.
highlights: Developed data pre-generation script using Python, resulting in a 70% reduction in test time for a population size of 20k.
Improved testing script with Jupyter and JSON that enabled test creation and logging with 20% overhead reduction.

Originated a community-aware diagonal splitting algorithm using a divide-and-conquer strategy which factored in community structure; the new algorithm needed 10% less tests compared to 5 other commonly-used algorithms.

projects.name: Ego2Allo - Toward Perspective-Taking Visual Reasoning
highlights: Fine-tuned VLMs for spatial perspective-taking tasks with SFT and RL-GRPO, achieving 10% higher accuracy.
Incorporated ReAct-based function calling to abstract perspective change agentic pipeline emphasizing structured reasoning, improving accuracy by 3%.

projects.name: Pittsburgh & CMU QA System
highlights: Collaborate in a team of 3 in building an end-to-end RAG QA system with multiple chunking granularities.

Created a Small-to-Big hybrid retriever that compute weighted fusion of BM25 score on sentence-level chunks and MiniLM-L6-v2 dense cosine similarity on paragraph-level chunks, achieving 75% accuracy under LLM evaluation.

projects.name: High Performance URL Shortening Web Server
highlights: Led a team of 4 in building a low-cost, high-performance async TCP server in C++ with Boost.Asio following test-driven development; authored a system design document and technical documentation to guide product architecture.
Designed application architecture design for a scalable URL shortening service with Redis caching and PostgreSQL persistence, leveraging connection pooling to support 1,000+ concurrent users.

Deployed service on Google Cloud Platform using Docker and Compute Engine; automated CI/CD with Cloud Build, to ensure zero-downtime deployments and automatic recovery through automated testing and health checks.

projects.name: Job Search Platform
highlights: Constructed a job search platform that personalized job recommendations merely based on user views and likes
Incorporated Search, Favorite, and Recommendation functionalities in Java Servlets with REST APIs to efficiently handle HTTP requests and responses.
Implemented frontend UI components using JavaScript, HTML, CSS, and Ajax, facilitating user login and enabling users to efficiently search and apply for positions.
Designed a recommendation engine with dense-embeddings and AI-based keyword extraction to model user interests; Prioritized user safety through session-based authentication.
Implemented Redis as a high-speed vector database to store job/user embeddings and precomputed results, reducing embedding API calls by 80%+ and enabling sub-millisecond cosine-similarity retrieval.
Configured and deployed on AWS EC2 virtual machine, combining Redis and Amazon RDS to cache and persist search and favorite related data, reducing latency by 90%.

projects.name: LLM Evaluation
projects.summary: Zero-shot evaluation framework for large language models.
highlights: Led a team of 4 in researching prompting techniques, enhancing the factual accuracy and fairness assessment of LLMs on textual claims.

Developed a zero-shot evaluation framework using Microsoft Phi-2 and Mistral-7B, incorporating GPT-generated evidence and chain-of-thought reasoning to assess designated tasks, achieving a 76% accuracy rate.

projects.name: Text-Guided Image Editing with Diffusion
projects.summary: Image editing via DiffEdit + BLIP with Stable Diffusion.
highlights: Reduced prompt restrictions and improved creation efficiency.

projects.name: Bruin-O-Bruin Web App
highlights: Coordinated with a team of 5 to build a full-stack elimination web game using Node.js, React framework, and SQLite.
Led implementation of core features including game randomization, discussion forum, and scoreboard; ensured instantaneous user interactions.

Launched account management features, including user registration, password protection with hashing, and password reset by using Node.js and SQLite; the feature led to 30% decrease in user support requests.
Launched on Azure VM and shared the app to our class forum; achieved over 50% class participation rate where players could compete on score leaderboard.
